description: This file defines the QuicSessionPeer class, a test utility for manipulating and inspecting QuicSession objects in the quiche/quic library, including stream ID management and stream state queries.

classes.name: QuicSessionPeer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manipulate and query QuicSession objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID for a given session.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID for a given session.

methods.name: SetNextOutgoingBidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Sets the next outgoing bidirectional stream ID for a session.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open incoming streams for a session (Google-QUIC only).

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open incoming bidirectional streams (IETF-QUIC only).

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open incoming unidirectional streams (IETF-QUIC only).

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open outgoing streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingBidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open outgoing bidirectional streams.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenOutgoingUnidirectionalStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of open outgoing unidirectional streams.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Retrieves the mutable QuicCryptoStream from a session.

methods.name: GetWriteBlockedStreams
methods.description: Retrieves the list of write-blocked streams.

methods.name: GetOrCreateStream
methods.description: Gets or creates a stream with a specified stream ID.

methods.name: GetLocallyClosedStreamsHighestOffset
methods.description: Returns a map of locally closed streams with their highest offsets.

methods.name: stream_map
methods.description: Accesses the stream map of a session.

methods.name: closed_streams
methods.description: Accesses the closed streams of a session.

methods.name: ActivateStream
methods.description: Activates a stream within a session.

methods.name: IsStreamClosed
methods.description: Checks if a stream is closed.

methods.name: IsStreamCreated
methods.description: Checks if a stream has been created.

methods.name: IsStreamAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a stream is available.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by ID.

methods.name: IsStreamWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a stream is write-blocked.

methods.name: GetCleanUpClosedStreamsAlarm
methods.description: Retrieves the alarm for cleaning up closed streams.

methods.name: GetStreamIdManager
methods.description: Retrieves the stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_streamid_manager
methods.description: Retrieves the IETF stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_bidirectional_stream_id_manager
methods.description: Retrieves the IETF bidirectional stream ID manager.

methods.name: ietf_unidirectional_stream_id_manager
methods.description: Retrieves the IETF unidirectional stream ID manager.

methods.name: GetPendingStream
methods.description: Retrieves a pending stream by ID.

methods.name: set_is_configured
methods.description: Sets the configuration state of a session.

methods.name: SetPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective of a session.

methods.name: GetNumOpenDynamicStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of open dynamic streams.

methods.name: GetNumDrainingStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of draining streams.

methods.name: GetLargestPeerCreatedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the largest peer-created stream ID for a session.
